title: Negative Influence as a Mean Change
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{-1,1\\}$ be monotone in the coordinatewise order, and let $J\\subseteq\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$. Write $\\mathbb E f$ for the uniform mean of the real-valued function obtained by viewing the signs output by $f$ as the numbers $\\pm1$. Let $f_{J,-}$ be the function obtained by setting every coordinate in $J$ to $-1$ before applying $f$. Then the coalitional influence of $f$ toward $-1$ equals $\\bigl(\\mathbb E f-\\mathbb E f_{J,-}\\bigr)/2$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the sign cube to the signs
